bullets.text: STL's Competitive Edge - **STL** leads the UK's connectivity growth with fiber and data center solutions, targeting hyperscalers.
UK Telcos Unite Against Scams - Major UK providers, including **BT** and **Vodafone**, commit to a new **Telecommunications Fraud Charter**.
Zoom's UK Data Centre Plans - **Zoom** will open a UK data center in 2026 to enhance local data residency and AI services.
BT's Revenue Decline - **BT** reports a 3% revenue drop, prompting significant job cuts amid competitive pressures.
Verizon and AWS Fiber Expansion - **Verizon** partners with **AWS** to build new fiber routes for AI workload demands.
Digital Catapult's Open RAN Testing - **Digital Catapult** welcomes new vendors to accelerate **Open RAN** trials in the UK.
Telefónica's Growth Strategy - **Telefónica** launches a strategic plan focused on AI-driven innovation and operational efficiency.
Changing Video Consumption Trends - Over half of UK viewers now prefer apps over traditional broadcasts, creating data challenges.
AI Infrastructure Bottleneck - **SK Telecom** aims to address AI demands with new data center initiatives in Korea and Vietnam.
AWS's Fastnet Cable Announcement - **AWS** plans a new transatlantic cable to enhance cloud and AI service resilience.
